title: Storage Rent for Closed Billing Periods Under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements
content:
Storage on a licensed agreement is billed in arrears, one billing period at a time, and the charge for a closed period is raised on the agreement's open storage invoice, the invoice carrying the charges the member has not yet settled. This entry governs storage rent on Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements.

## What the entry covers

The rent for a period that has closed on a member's storage agreement is worked out by the desk and recorded against that agreement, naming the period billed, the quantity the period was billed on and the money charged, and billing it on the storage invoice the agreement's unsettled charges stand on. The line goes onto the storage account standing unpaid, so the money is on what the member owes the elevator from that moment. Nothing else on the agreement moves: the bushels on hand, the grade of record and the date storage is billed and paid through are all left as they stand.

## Recording the charge

The recording tool is `charge_storage_accrual_0a686c89`. It is a hidden tool: the desk unlocks it and then calls it itself, the charge being the elevator's own write rather than the member's.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agreement_id` | the internal reference number of the storage agreement being billed | as returned by the storage agreement lookup for this member |
| `invoice_number` | the storage invoice this period's rent is billed on | written as SI- followed by six digits, for example SI-660014, taken exactly as it appears on the storage account rows it is to join; an empty value is not accepted |
| `period_start` | the first day of the billing period being charged | a calendar date written as four digits, two digits and two digits separated by hyphens, with no time part and no time zone |
| `period_end` | the last day of the billing period being charged, counted inclusively | the same calendar date form, with no time part and no time zone |
| `bushels` | the quantity the period was billed on | bushels to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the second decimal, never blank |
| `amount` | the money charged for the period | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent, always positive on a charge |

### What comes back

A single line of confirmation text carrying the new storage account line's own reference, the storage invoice the line was billed on, the period it covers as two calendar dates, and the amount charged in USD to 2 decimal places. Receiving that line means the accrual is on the member's storage account and standing unpaid; no other line is written.

## Notes for the desk

**What does the confirmation prove?** That one accrual line stands on the storage account, unpaid, for the period named. It does not prove that anything else on the agreement has moved, because nothing else does.

**Which invoice does the rent go on?** The storage invoice the agreement's unsettled charges stand on, given exactly as it appears on those rows.
